title: A woman in a rustic farmhouse kitchen, wearing a white blouse and pink apron, prepares an ...
description:
A woman in a rustic farmhouse kitchen, wearing a white blouse and pink apron, prepares an extensive home-cooked meal throughout the day. She begins by rinsing and chopping herbs, mixing ground meat, and rolling stuffed grape leaves which are then cooked in a pot with lemon slices. She bakes bread in a green AGA stove, removes it, and later makes focaccia dough, drizzling it with olive oil before a young child helps place it in the oven. Outside, she and two young girls harvest large rhubarb stalks from a garden bed near a greenhouse, then return inside to chop the rhubarb and roast it on a sheet pan. She prepares chia pudding with milk and protein powder, topping jars with the roasted rhubarb. She also roasts a large cut of meat, shreds it, and assembles layered salad jars with greens and vegetables. A young girl helps mix chopped zucchini, squash, and beets for roasting. Finally, she makes oat-based granola bars, pressing the mixture into a pan and covering it with melted bone broth hot cocoa chocolate, which she and the children taste together. The video concludes with her placing finished dishes into a refrigerator, showcasing a full day of from-scratch, farm-to-table cooking with family involvement.
